crossRefs.note: These are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a fitted tunic, a turban, and a sash.…
“You shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, ‘HOLY TO YAHWEH.’
You shall set the turban on his head, and put the holy crown on the turban.
the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands of fine linen, the linen trousers of fine twined linen,
I said, “Let them set a clean turban on his head.” So they set a clean turban on his head, and clothed him; and…
Yes, take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them on the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest;
Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,

parallels.note: You shall set the turban on his head, and put the holy crown on the turban.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: He set the turban on his head. He set the golden plate, the holy crown, on the front of the turban, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
translations.bsb: Moses also put the turban on Aaron’s head and set the gold plate, the holy diadem, on the front of the turban, as the LORD had commanded him.
translations.kjv: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, even upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.asv: And he set the mitre upon his head; and upon the mitre, in front, did he set the golden plate, the holy crown; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
